The Cloud Observatory

Domed observatories float on islands of lavender cloud, joined by delicate bridges, with brass telescopes turned towards a midnight sky of golden constellations and a great pale moon. A room built for exploring the stars. Painted with a soft gouache-and-watercolour feel, and sized to your wall.
